title: _withdrawFrom Rounding Edge Cases
description: The surplus calculation (`totalBalanceOf - principalOf`) may report 0 due to ERC4626 rounding even when yield actually exists. This can cause surplus withdrawal functionality to fail in edge cases.
impact: Minor DoS on surplus withdrawal functionality in edge cases. Users may be unable to withdraw small amounts of surplus due to rounding.
attackPath: User has earned small amount of yield
Surplus calculation returns 0 despite yield existing
User cannot withdraw their earned surplus
codeSnippet: // Surplus = totalBalanceOf - principalOf may round to 0
recommendation: Add a small tolerance for rounding errors in surplus calculations to handle edge cases where yield exists but rounds to zero.
